headline: Pauny Tractor Factory Occupied by Workers Amid Escalating Wage Conflict
summary: Workers at Pauny took over the factory following a second fruitless audience between company representatives and the UOM union over delayed wages and employer obligations, amid a delicate financial situation.
why: Pauny is a prominent Argentine tractor manufacturer employing hundreds of workers, and labor disruptions reflect severe industrial and macroeconomic headwinds in the agricultural machinery sector.

impacts.name: Industrial Manufacturing
impacts.why: Factory occupation and labor strikes disrupt manufacturing output and corporate productivity.
